reason: Primary coded variable is presence of a continuation header or link: a platform-convention marker of the entry's place in the author's posting sequence, not realized quality.
Counts actual textual defects (name variants, tense flips, dropped words) no reader treats as intent. Measures the polish a reread produced, not the timing trace.
Presence/absence only cannot separate a deliberate open ending from running out of time, so it captures truncation and serialization convention, i.e. the timing trace.
